startup_seconds.note: process start to the first buffer on the toplevel's surface, median of three launches

memory_mebibytes.note: proportional set size of the whole process tree, one Space, one page

space_mebibytes.note: what each Space after the first adds, each holding the same page

frozen_growth_mebibytes.note: what an away Space's page goes on taking once frozen, against ADR 0033
